children: Howard Amster disclosed a 9.0% stake in Redwood Trust, Inc., reporting beneficial ownership of 11,269,634 shares. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 25, 2026 after a series of open‑market purchases from July through September. The size of the stake gives Amster room to press for strategic and governance changes at the mortgage REIT.

Amster bought the shares for investment, but he leaves the door open to a more active role. He says he may "engag[e] in communications with management and the Board of Directors" and consider "making recommendations or proposals... including board structure" as he reviews Redwood Trust’s performance.

He may buy more shares, sell some or all of his position, or use hedging tools, and he could discuss potential business combinations or asset moves with other shareholders. He has not struck any agreement for a board seat or transaction, but he signals he will act if he sees ways to improve Redwood Trust’s financial and operational results.

Howard Amster is a United States investor who oversees a network of entities and trusts, including Pleasant Lake Apartments Corp. and the Howard Amster Foundation. He serves as president of Pleasant Lake Apartments Corp., is the majority owner and a director of Horizon Group Properties Inc., and acts as trustee for multiple charitable remainder trusts. Amster is known as a value-driven investor who focuses on real estate and income-oriented securities with an opportunistic, long-term approach.
